🎬 My Spy (2020)

My Spy follows JJ, a tough CIA operative whose career takes an unexpected turn when a routine surveillance mission goes wrong. Assigned to monitor a family in Chicago, JJ finds himself outsmarted by Sophie, a clever nine-year-old girl who discovers his secret identity. Instead of exposing him, Sophie makes a deal: she will keep his secret if he teaches her how to become a spy. What begins as an unusual arrangement quickly turns into a hilarious friendship as the unlikely duo navigates secret missions, awkward situations, and unexpected dangers. As JJ grows closer to Sophie and her mother, he discovers that protecting others requires more than physical strength. Starring Dave Bautista and Chloe Coleman, My Spy combines action-packed adventures, heartwarming moments, and family-friendly humor.

🎭 Genre: Action • Comedy • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 39m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Peter Segal

✍️ Writers: Jon Hoeber & Erich Hoeber

📺 Where to Watch: Amazon Prime Video in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: My Spy is a 2020 American action comedy film produced and directed by Peter Segal from a script by Jon and Erich Hoeber. It stars Dave Bautista, Chloe Coleman in her film debut, Kristen Schaal, Parisa Fitz-Henley, and Ken Jeong. It follows a CIA agent who finds himself at the mercy of a precocious nine-year-old girl in a family that he and his tech support are surveilling while undercover. My Spy was released theatrically on January 9, 2020 in Australia by STX Entertainment. On April 8, 2020, its distribution rights were purchased by Amazon Studios due to the COVID-19 pandemic having shut down theaters worldwide.
